findings.title: Unindexed OR clause in deleteMany causes full table scan on WorkflowReminder
findings.body: In `packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleSMSReminders.ts`, `prisma.workflowReminder.deleteMany` was changed to use an `OR` condition combining `{ method: WorkflowMethods.SMS, scheduledDate: { lte: ... } }` and `{ retryCount: { gt: 1 } }`. However, `retryCount` is not indexed on `WorkflowReminder` in `packages/prisma/schema.prisma`, and the second `OR` branch does not filter by `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS`. In PostgreSQL, an `OR` across an unindexed column forces a sequential scan of the entire `WorkflowReminder` table on every cron invocation, and would also delete non-SMS reminders if any ever had `retryCount > 1`. Scope `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` to the top-level `where` clause and either add an index covering `retryCount` or delete the reminder directly when `reminder.retryCount >= 1` upon failure instead of incrementing and scanning in `deleteMany`.
